standard (default)
  Bash sandbox       on, and Bash refuses to run when it cannot start
  Denied files       ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.gnupg, ~/.config/gh, ~/.netrc, ~/.docker/config.json,
                     ~/.kube, ~/.npmrc, ~/.pypirc, ~/.config/gcloud, ~/.azure, ~/.git-credentials
  Unset variables    ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN,
                     AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET, CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN,
                     DIGITALOCEAN_ACCESS_TOKEN, DOCKER_PASSWORD, GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN,
                     GITLAB_TOKEN, GOOGLE_API_KEY, HF_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN,
                     OPENAI_API_KEY, PYPI_API_TOKEN, SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY,
                     TWINE_PASSWORD, VAULT_TOKEN
  Environment        inherited by subprocesses
  .env files         ask before reading
  Outside reads      allowed
  Network            allowed hosts pass, other hosts ask
  Allowed hosts      none
  Also writable      nothing outside the project
  Unsandboxed        a blocked command may run outside the sandbox after a prompt
  bypassPermissions  refused

strict
  Bash sandbox       on, and Bash refuses to run when it cannot start
  Denied files       ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.gnupg, ~/.config/gh, ~/.netrc, ~/.docker/config.json,
                     ~/.kube, ~/.npmrc, ~/.pypirc, ~/.config/gcloud, ~/.azure, ~/.git-credentials
  Unset variables    ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN,
                     AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET, CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN,
                     DIGITALOCEAN_ACCESS_TOKEN, DOCKER_PASSWORD, GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN,
                     GITLAB_TOKEN, GOOGLE_API_KEY, HF_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN,
                     OPENAI_API_KEY, PYPI_API_TOKEN, SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY,
                     TWINE_PASSWORD, VAULT_TOKEN
  Environment        credentials scrubbed from every subprocess (Bash, hooks, MCP servers)
  .env files         never read
  Outside reads      blocked outside the working directories
  Network            only allowed hosts
  Allowed hosts      github.com, api.github.com, codeload.github.com, objects.githubusercontent.com,
                     raw.githubusercontent.com
  Also writable      nothing outside the project
  Unsandboxed        never
  bypassPermissions  allowed

off
  Bash sandbox       off
  Denied files       none
  Unset variables    none
  Environment        inherited by subprocesses
  .env files         readable
  Outside reads      allowed
  Network            open
  Allowed hosts      none
  Also writable      nothing outside the project
  Unsandboxed        every command runs without a sandbox
  bypassPermissions  refused

Isolation levels (sandbox.isolation or --isolation)
  bash       Bash commands, in the Claude Code sandbox
  process    the whole Claude process, in the sandbox runtime
  container  the whole workspace, in the dev container

bypassPermissions needs the strict profile or container isolation.
